d: Short, textured ash-brown hair with a side parting and a small silver clip on the left side. Narrow, tired-looking dark brown eyes on a mature face appearing to be in the early twenties. A lean, athletic build dressed in a crisp white long-sleeved button-down shirt with rolled sleeves, tucked into slim-fit black trousers with a black leather belt and black dress shoes.
